title: Daily digest: Bhatti calls Dalits, tribals to unite un | Aadhaar Face Authentication Mandatory Fo | India rejects Kashmir references in Turk | Taiwan says U.S. arms sales to island ar
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: Bhatti calls Dalits, tribals to unite under Congress.
Aadhaar Face Authentication Mandatory For Police Recruitment.
India rejects Kashmir references in Turkish President’s UNGA address as ‘unwarranted’.
Taiwan says U.S. arms sales to island are unchanged, but a $14 billion package remains on hold.
bullets_ur: Bhatti ne Daliton aur qabailiyon ko Congress ke tehat mutahid honay ki dawat di.
Police bharti ke liye Aadhaar Face Authentication lazmi.
India ne Turkish President ke UNGA address mein Kashmir ka zikr "ghair zaroori" qarar de kar mustarad kar diya.
Taiwan ka kehna hai ke U.S. ka hathiyaaron ka bechna badla nahi, lekin $14 billion ka package abhi tak roka hua hai.
